name: Tracking Alpha

name: Wave Radar
summary: Screens 7,000+ US and Asian stocks for 75 technical signals and shows each signal's historical win rate on that stock, with gamma exposure, fair-value bands, insider and 13F data and a daily community fear-and-greed reading. AI summarizes macro data and breaking news, and for heavily discussed stocks a combined model of technicals, news, insider trades, gamma, valuation, earnings, sentiment and fund flow estimates the next few sessions' move. Free account available.
